provenance.status: Original procedural reconstruction; not a retail mesh reproduction.
provenance.dimensions: Authored estimates in metres; not measured stock data.
provenance.rig: Guide-based authored family interpretation. Stock sail-plan/locator geometry was unavailable.
provenance.gun_layout: Authored symmetric broadside allocation of the verified stock total. z_m is the row centre at zero sheer; the builder adds the authored local deck sheer. This is not a claim about stock gun locators.
provenance.stock_script_caveat: Pinned stock-derived modern compatibility scripts are not authenticated byte-identical retail source.

source_evidence.claim: Family, model identifier, class and total cannon count only.
Ordinary family identity; no dimension or sail-plan data.
General game visual vocabulary only: pale panelled square canvas, dark wales and ochre hull bands. The pictured family is not authenticated.
Authored hull/port/mast proportion method and rig distinctions; not stock game dimensions.
Square/lateen/gaff typology and spar proportion starting points; later brig is not the reference Snow.

type_profile.distinction: Slender three-masted, 32-gun corvette with a flush main deck and single open battery; square fore/main and square upper mizzen with a gaff spanker.
type_profile.rationale: Stock-derived scripts give the Corvette 32 guns and higher speed/turn rates than the Frigate. A single battery, low superstructure and finer lines distinguish the authored corvette from the frigate.

scope.delivered: Static duel asset with two paint variants and LOD/collision/review assets.
scope.engine_integration: Not integrated with an engine: no buoyancy, damage, artillery, sailing or crew controllers.
scope.walking: Authored geometric passage and stair access; no player controller or engine navigation integration. Actual clearance checks are recorded in validation.json after build.
scope.interiors: Modelled structural interiors with real planked decks, frames, hatch apertures, stairs and cabin partition openings. Layout is an authored reconstruction, not recovered retail geometry.

evidence.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Ganymede (captured 1809), ZAZ3644
evidence.kind: Primary Portsmouth Dockyard survey plan catalogue
evidence.observed: The catalogue identifies the lower-deck plan of the captured French corvette Ganymede before fitting as a 24-gun sixth rate.
evidence.application: A non-battery lower deck below the flush main gun deck, with aft accommodation and storage.
evidence.limit: The analogue has a different rating and size. The ordinary POTC Corvette remains 32 guns with the original flush-deck silhouette.

evidence.title: Royal Museums Greenwich: Ganymede (captured 1809), ZAZ3645
evidence.kind: Primary Portsmouth Dockyard survey plan catalogue
evidence.observed: The matching museum record identifies a separate upper-deck survey of the same captured French corvette.
evidence.application: Keep the working main deck and its single battery visually distinct from the enclosed berth deck.
evidence.limit: Only deck hierarchy is transferred; no added second battery or borrowed plan coordinates.

notes: Flush main deck with one 32-gun battery, three square-rigged masts and no castles. Main hatch enters a continuous non-battery berth deck whose centered level door opens into the real cabin; framed provision hold remains below.
The authored cabin-front partition is placed aft of the preserved mizzen and its complete doorway approach; the centered 1.15 m door and main-hatch connection remain full-size.
